summary.headline: Judging Children in Natal Astrology
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging the timing of children from the significator of children, the lot of children, planetary locations, Jupiter and Venus, annual revolutions, and profections. Mutual aspects, reception, fortune, and impediment indicate concord, affection, benevolence, discord, or enmity between children and the native.
